definitions.explanation: Being the exact thing or equal in value or quality.

examples.japanese: {同|おな}じ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{同|おな}じ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: We go to the same school.
This and that are the same.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{同|おな}じ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同|おな}じ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I ended up buying the same clothes as my older sister.

notes:
{同|おな}じ means 'same' or 'identical.' It has unusual grammar—acting as both pre-noun adjectival and predicate.

GRAMMAR PATTERNS:
- {同|おな}じ + noun: the same ~ ({同|おな}じ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧)
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同|おな}じ: same as ~ (A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{同|おな}じ⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧)
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同|おな}じ⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧: in the same way as ~
- ⟦{同|おな}じく→同じく：noentry⟧: likewise, similarly (adverb)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {同|おな}じ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧: same age
- {同|おな}じ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: same time
- {同|おな}じ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧: same opinion

GRAMMAR NOTE:
{同|おな}じ is grammatically unusual—it modifies nouns directly (like a pre-noun adjectival) but also works as a predicate ({同|おな}じ⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧).

CONTRAST:
- ⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧: different (antonym)
- ⟦{似|に}ている→似る：01159_niru⟧: similar (not identical)
